title: Precise asymptotic estimates and non-degeneracy of solutions to a biharmonic problem with large exponents in dimension four
summary: We are concerned with the semilinear biharmonic problem under Dirichlet boundary conditions that \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} Δ^2 u=(u^+)^{p} &{\text{in}~Ω},\\[0.5mm] u \not\equiv 0 &{\text{in}~Ω},\\[0.5mm] u=\partial u / \partial ν= 0 &{\text{on}~\partial Ω}, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^4$ is a smooth bounded domain and $p>1$ is sufficiently large. The basic asymptotic behavior and concentration phenomena of the solutions for this problem have been established in literatures.
